suit_agi01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Agility <@ba.vup>+50.0</>. 
When the wearer's HP is above 80%, <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> <@ba.vup>+20%</>.

suit_atb01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction <@ba.vup>+15%</>.
After the wearer's skill recovers SP, the team gains DMG <@ba.vup>+16%</> for 15.0s. This effect cannot stack.

suit_atk01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG <@ba.vup>+24%</>. 
When the wearer casts a battle skill, combo skill, or ultimate, the wearer gains ATK <@ba.vup>+5%</> for 15.0s. The buff from each of the three skill types is unique and does not stack with itself.

suit_atk02.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+15%</>. 
When any operator in the team casts a battle skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of <@ba.key>Yinglung's Edge</> that gives DMG <@ba.vup>+20%</> to the wearer's next combo skill. <@ba.key>Yinglung's Edge</> can stack 3 time(s).

suit_attri01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+15%</>. 
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of <@ba.key>Bonekrushing Smash</> that grants the wearer's next battle skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+30%</>. <@ba.key>Bonekrushing Smash</> can stack 2 time(s).

suit_burst01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+20%</>.
After the wearer applies <@ba.key>2.0</> or more stacks of <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> on the enemy, the wearer gains <@ba.key>Arts DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+35%</> for 15.0s. This effect cannot stack.

suit_combo_cd01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction <@ba.vup>+15%</>.
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains Skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+20%</> (for every skill) for 15.0s. This effect can reach 2.0 stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

suit_criti01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Critical Rate <@ba.vup>+5%</>. 
After the wearer scores a critical hit, the wearer gains ATK <@ba.vup>+5%</> for 5.0s. This effect can reach 5 stacks. At max stacks, grant an additional Critical Rate <@ba.vup>+5%</>. This effect cannot stack.

suit_crush_fracture.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+8%</>.
When the wearer applies <#ba.crush>Crush</> or <#ba.fracture>Breach</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pd>Physical DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+[6% × Max number of <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stacks <#ba.consume>consumed</> from one enemy]</> for 20.0s. If the target already has <#ba.physicalvul>Physical Susceptibility</>, is <@ba.poise>Staggered</>, or has attached <#ba.originium>Originium Crystals</>, increase the aforementioned buff to <@ba.vup>1.5</> times. This buff cannot stack.

suit_expend_spell01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+10%</>.
Whenever the wearer <#ba.consume>consumes</> <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> or <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, the wearer gains a number of buff stacks equal to the <#ba.statuslevel>Status Level</> of the Arts Reaction consumed, with each buff stack giving <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG Dealt</> and <@ba.natur>Nature DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+15%</> for 25.0s. Max number of buff stacks: 3.0. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

suit_fire_natr01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+30</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.burning>Combustion</>, the wearer gains <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> +<@ba.vup>50%</> for 10.0s. After the wearer applies <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, the wearer gains <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> +<@ba.vup>50%</> for 10.0s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

suit_generaltype.description: 3-piece set effect: Wearer gains DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+20%</> for all types of DMG, <@ba.vup>10%</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG, and Ultimate Gain Efficiency <@ba.vup>+10%</>.

suit_heal01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP Treatment Efficiency <@ba.vup>+20%</>. 
After the wearer gives HP treatment to an allied target, that target also gains <@ba.vup>15%</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG for 10.0s. If the said treatment exceeds the target's Max HP, the target gains <@ba.vup>30%</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

suit_phy01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Stagger Efficiency Bonus <@ba.vup>+20%</>.
After the wearer applies a <#ba.physicalstatus>Physical Status</>, the wearer also performs 1 hit that deals 250% ATK of Physical DMG and [<@ba.poise>10.0</> Stagger]. Effect trigger cooldown: 15.0s.

suit_poise01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+8%</>.
After the wearer applies <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pd>Physical DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+8%</> for 15.0s. This effect can reach 4 stacks. If the target has 4 stacks of <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains an additional <@ba.pd>Physical DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+16%</> for 10.0s. This effect cannot stack.

suit_pulse_cryst01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+30</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</><@ba.vup> +50%</> for 10.0s. After the wearer applies <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>, the wearer gains <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</><@ba.vup> +50%</> for 10.0s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

suit_spellburst.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+16%</>.
When the wearer applies <#ba.naturalburst>Nature Burst</> or <#ba.crystburst>Cryo Burst</>, the wearer gains Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+16</> for 20.0s. Max stacks for this effect: 3.0. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.1s.

suit_str01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Strength <@ba.vup>+50.0</>. 
When the wearer's HP is below 50%, the wearer gains <@ba.vup>30%</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG.

suit_stragi01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP <@ba.vup>+500.0</>. 
After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer restores <@ba.heal>100.0</> HP. Effect trigger cooldown: 5.0s.

suit_usp01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Ultimate Gain Efficiency <@ba.vup>+20%</>.
The wearer casts a battle skill, the action <#ba.return>returns</> <@ba.vup>50</> SP. This effect only triggers 1 time per battle.

suit_usp02.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP <@ba.vup>+1000.0</>.
After the wearer applies <#ba.enhance>Amp</>, <#ba.guard>Protection</>, <#ba.vulnerable>Susceptibility</>, or <#ba.weak>Weakness</>, other teammates gain DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+16%</> for 15.0s. This effect cannot stack.

suit_will01.description:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Will <@ba.vup>+50.0</>. 
When the wearer's HP is below 50%, Treatment Effect <@ba.vup>+30%</>.

suit_wisd01.description:

When the wearer's HP is above 80%, <@ba.key>Arts DMG</> <@ba.vup>+20%</>.

3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP <@ba.vup>+500.0</>.
